name: members
about: Filter the member list and open this node's own record. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

steps.say: open the Members tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Members tab is selected and the members view shows a Members label, a summary such as 'N humans, M agents', filter buttons Show all members, Show humans only, Show agents only and Show validators only with Show all members checked, and member rows; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
Show validators only reports checked; the rows shown are validators (role label Validator) or there are none

steps.say: press this node's own row (the row with the This node label)
steps.expect: a member record opens with a Close member button and a Copy this node's key button
the record is closed: no Close member button
